verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents the building pieces of a scoped card: instant virtual card issuance, merchant locks via authorization controls, and amount and frequency caps via velocity controls. Its agentic-AI MCP guide lists virtual card issuance and spend controls (caps, merchant restrictions) next to AI agents. However, that page frames agents as operators of the API rather than documenting, by name, a card issued to an agent as its own scoped payment instrument. The evidence also shows no per-card expiry control; card state transitions are not the same thing. missing for 10: explicit documented 'card for an AI agent' use case, per-card expiry or time-bound validity, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-scoped cards.
